messages:
anya: Kicking off v2.1-int8 as a shadow across 10% traffic. want a quick consensus on the promote/fallback gates before we scale. noticed a small regression on the long-doc benchmark vs v2.0 (more details below). tagging folks who care.

sam: Can you paste the stats you saw? numbers help.

anya: quick paste from the eval job:```
longdoc_f1: 0.872 -> 0.860 (-1.38% relative)
short_q_acc: 0.948 -> 0.947 (-0.11% relative)
latency_p95: 220ms -> 235ms (+6.8%)
notes: delta mostly on sequences > 3k tokens (kv-cache warmups inconsistent)
```

marta: ok that longdoc F1 is notable but not catastrophic. propose these initial gates:
- auto-fallback if relative f1 drop >= 2.0% on the long-doc slice OR absolute drop >= 0.02
- soft-hold (stop promotion) if relative f1 drop between 1.0% and 2.0% and latency_p95 increase > 5%
- tie-breaker: prefer higher fidelity model on human eval sample of 500 docs
(also include a cooldown window of 6h for noise) :thinking_face:

leo: fwiw the kv cache rewarm behavior could create a transient bias on long docs. can we check coldstart slice separately? i saw that cold requests spike error / lower perf.

deploy-bot: Shadow run started for model=v2.1-int8, traffic=10%, start_ts=3322109876

anya: good call @leo. plan: run the standard shadow slice diffs and a targeted coldstart cohort (requests with session_age < 30s). config I was thinking to push to rollout service:```yaml
canary: 10%
watch_metrics:
  - name: longdoc_f1
    window: 12h
    threshold_relative: -0.02
  - name: latency_p95
    window: 6h
    threshold_relative: 0.08
actions:
  - on_fail: fallback_to: v2.0
  - on_soft_hold: notify: [eng-ml, sde-oncall]
  - cooldown: 6h
```

sam: I like the cooldown. also recommend capturing token-level diffs for a small random sample so we can inspect hallucination patterns. add a logging hook for mismatched tokens and top-k probabilities.

marta: i'll run the targeted eval against the 1k long-doc hand-labeled set and post results to the /shared/artifacts link <https://redwood.internal/artifacts/rdw-v2-qual|artifacts>. will also surface token-diff snapshots. ETA 4h.

anya: perfect. we'll let shadow run for 12h minimum, review the automated alerts and Marta's run. if no automatic fallback and metrics stable -> promote to 30% tomorrow morning. thanks all :team_parrot:
